topic: Why electricity costs and the Bitcoin price decide mining profitability
hook: Mining rewards come in bitcoin. The bills arrive in regular money.

scenes.narration: Electricity and hosting are paid in regular currency, and electricity is usually the biggest ongoing cost.
So a falling bitcoin price or a rising power price can squeeze mining returns. Results vary, and they are never certain.

cta: Want to dig deeper? There's a link on my channel page if you'd like to explore digital mining.
title: Why Electricity Decides if Bitcoin Mining Pays
description_body: Rewards arrive in BTC while costs are paid in fiat, so profitability moves with the bitcoin price and power costs.

thumbnail.line2: REWARDS IN BTC, COSTS IN CASH
